about: Cochrane is a town on the Bow River in Alberta’s foothills, immediately west of Calgary—not the northern Ontario town of the same name. It has grown rapidly from a ranch-supply village into a commuter town with a western storefront downtown and the Cochrane Ranche historic site on the hill. Mackay’s ice cream lineup is a local ritual on Main Street. About 32,000 people live in Cochrane.
seoSummary: Foothills town on the Bow River west of Calgary, a former ranch village with a western downtown—not Cochrane, Ontario.
